# Read-only Contract View Links Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build expiring, single-purpose read-only contract links that render TipTap content before a provider PDF exists and render PDF once the document is in the signing/PDF lifecycle.

**Architecture:** Add a new `VIEW_ONLY` document access token type, generated by an authenticated document endpoint and consumed by new public `/public/view/:token` endpoints. Keep this separate from signing tokens so viewing never grants signing permissions. Backend returns a discriminated view model (`mode: content | pdf | unavailable`); frontend renders either `DocumentEditor editable={false}` or a lightweight PDF viewer.

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.25, Gin, PostgreSQL/pgx, Wire, Swagger, React 19, TanStack Router, React Query, TipTap, react-pdf, Docker local stack, browser-use in-app browser.

## API contracts

### Authenticated link generation

`POST /api/v1/documents/{documentId}/view-link`

Middleware:

```go
docs.POST("/:documentId/view-link", middleware.RequireViewer(), c.CreateReadonlyViewLink)
```

Response:

```json
{
  "url": "/public/view/6a...128hex",
  "token": "6a...128hex",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-08T12:00:00Z"
}
```

### Public view metadata

`GET /public/view/{token}`

Response examples:

```json
{
  "mode": "content",
  "documentId": "doc-id",
  "documentTitle": "Contrato de servicio",
  "documentStatus": "AWAITING_INPUT",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-08T12:00:00Z",
  "content": {
    "type": "doc",
    "content": [{ "type": "paragraph", "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "Contrato" }] }]
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "mode": "pdf",
  "documentId": "doc-id",
  "documentTitle": "Contrato de servicio",
  "documentStatus": "SIGNING",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-08T12:00:00Z",
  "pdfUrl": "/public/view/6a...128hex/pdf"
}
```

```json
{
  "mode": "unavailable",
  "documentId": "doc-id",
  "documentTitle": "Contrato de servicio",
  "documentStatus": "CANCELLED",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-08T12:00:00Z",
  "reason": "document_unavailable"
}
```

### Public PDF bytes

`GET /public/view/{token}/pdf`

- Validates token and token type.
- For completed document: use existing completed PDF retrieval path.
- For non-completed but provider-attempt/PDF lifecycle states: render/download the current preview PDF using the immutable template version + injected values + field responses. Keep this first implementation simple by rendering on demand using the existing PDF renderer path; do not enqueue River work from the view endpoint.

---

## Mode rules

Use this simple status mapping:

```go
func readonlyViewModeForStatus(status entity.DocumentStatus) documentuc.ReadonlyViewMode {
    switch status {
    case entity.DocumentStatusDraft, entity.DocumentStatusAwaitingInput:
        return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeContent
    case entity.DocumentStatusPreparingSignature,
        entity.DocumentStatusReadyToSign,
        entity.DocumentStatusSigning,
        entity.DocumentStatusCompleted:
        return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModePDF
    default:
        return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeUnavailable
    }
}
```

If PDF rendering/downloading fails for `PREPARING_SIGNATURE`, `READY_TO_SIGN`, or `SIGNING`, return a typed error to the frontend so the page shows “El PDF aún se está preparando” and allows retry. Do not fall back to editable/signing UI.

For each task after Task 1:

1. **R — Reproduce/Red:** write or run a failing test that proves the missing behavior.
2. **A — Analyze:** inspect the smallest relevant code seam and state the expected fix in the worker notes.
3. **L — Local fix:** implement the smallest code change.
4. **P — Prove:** run the narrow test and inspect the diff.
5. **H — Harden:** run the broader relevant check. If it fails, repeat R/A/L/P/H until solved or until the same failure repeats three times.

Stop after three identical failures and report exact commands, output, and the decision needed.

```go
package document

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/TetherEducation/doc-assembly/core/internal/core/entity"
	"github.com/TetherEducation/doc-assembly/core/internal/core/port"
	documentuc "github.com/TetherEducation/doc-assembly/core/internal/core/usecase/document"
)

// ReadonlyViewService handles expiring read-only contract links.
type ReadonlyViewService struct {
	documentRepo     port.DocumentRepository
	versionRepo      port.TemplateVersionRepository
	recipientRepo    port.DocumentRecipientRepository
	signerRoleRepo   port.TemplateVersionSignerRoleRepository
	accessTokenRepo  port.DocumentAccessTokenRepository
	fieldResponseRepo port.FieldResponseRepository
	pdfRenderer      port.PDFRenderer
	storageAdapter   port.StorageAdapter
	storageEnabled   bool
	publicURL        string
	tokenTTLHours    int
}

// NewReadonlyViewService creates a read-only view service.
func NewReadonlyViewService(
	documentRepo port.DocumentRepository,
	versionRepo port.TemplateVersionRepository,
	recipientRepo port.DocumentRecipientRepository,
	signerRoleRepo port.TemplateVersionSignerRoleRepository,
	accessTokenRepo port.DocumentAccessTokenRepository,
	fieldResponseRepo port.FieldResponseRepository,
	pdfRenderer port.PDFRenderer,
	storageAdapter port.StorageAdapter,
	storageEnabled bool,
	publicURL string,
	tokenTTLHours int,
) *ReadonlyViewService {
	return &ReadonlyViewService{
		documentRepo:      documentRepo,
		versionRepo:       versionRepo,
		recipientRepo:     recipientRepo,
		signerRoleRepo:    signerRoleRepo,
		accessTokenRepo:   accessTokenRepo,
		fieldResponseRepo: fieldResponseRepo,
		pdfRenderer:       pdfRenderer,
		storageAdapter:    storageAdapter,
		storageEnabled:    storageEnabled,
		publicURL:         strings.TrimRight(publicURL, "/"),
		tokenTTLHours:     tokenTTLHours,
	}
}

// CreateReadonlyViewLink creates a fresh expiring VIEW_ONLY token.
func (s *ReadonlyViewService) CreateReadonlyViewLink(ctx context.Context, documentID string) (*documentuc.CreateReadonlyViewLinkResult, error) {
	doc, err := s.documentRepo.FindByID(ctx, documentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finding document: %w", err)
	}
	if doc.Status == entity.DocumentStatusInvalidated || doc.Status == entity.DocumentStatusCancelled || doc.IsExpired() {
		return nil, entity.ErrInvalidDocumentState
	}

	tokenStr, err := generateAccessToken()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	expiresAt := now.Add(time.Duration(s.tokenTTLHours) * time.Hour)
	accessToken := &entity.DocumentAccessToken{
		DocumentID: doc.ID,
		Token:      tokenStr,
		TokenType:  entity.TokenTypeViewOnly,
		ExpiresAt:  expiresAt,
		CreatedAt:  now,
	}
	if err := s.accessTokenRepo.Create(ctx, accessToken); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating readonly view token: %w", err)
	}

	path := "/public/view/" + tokenStr
	url := path
	if s.publicURL != "" {
		url = s.publicURL + path
	}

	return &documentuc.CreateReadonlyViewLinkResult{URL: url, Token: tokenStr, ExpiresAt: expiresAt}, nil
}

var _ documentuc.ReadonlyViewUseCase = (*ReadonlyViewService)(nil)
```

If actual port interface names differ, inspect `/Users/rendis/Documents/Projects/Libraries/doc-assembly/core/internal/core/port` and adjust to existing names only.

```go
func (s *ReadonlyViewService) GetReadonlyView(ctx context.Context, token string) (*documentuc.ReadonlyViewResponse, error) {
	accessToken, err := s.validateReadonlyToken(ctx, token)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	doc, err := s.documentRepo.FindByID(ctx, accessToken.DocumentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finding document: %w", err)
	}

	resp := &documentuc.ReadonlyViewResponse{
		Mode:           readonlyViewModeForStatus(doc.Status),
		DocumentID:     doc.ID,
		DocumentTitle:  documentTitle(doc),
		DocumentStatus: doc.Status,
		ExpiresAt:      accessToken.ExpiresAt,
	}

	switch resp.Mode {
	case documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeContent:
		content, err := s.loadReadonlyContent(ctx, doc)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		resp.Content = content
	case documentuc.ReadonlyViewModePDF:
		pdfURL := "/public/view/" + token + "/pdf"
		resp.PDFURL = &pdfURL
	case documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeUnavailable:
		reason := "document_unavailable"
		resp.Reason = &reason
	}

	return resp, nil
}

func (s *ReadonlyViewService) validateReadonlyToken(ctx context.Context, token string) (*entity.DocumentAccessToken, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(token) == "" {
		return nil, entity.ErrMissingToken
	}
	accessToken, err := s.accessTokenRepo.FindByToken(ctx, token)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, entity.ErrInvalidToken
	}
	if !accessToken.IsViewOnly() {
		return nil, entity.ErrInvalidToken
	}
	if time.Now().UTC().After(accessToken.ExpiresAt) {
		return nil, entity.ErrTokenExpired
	}
	return accessToken, nil
}

func readonlyViewModeForStatus(status entity.DocumentStatus) documentuc.ReadonlyViewMode {
	switch status {
	case entity.DocumentStatusDraft, entity.DocumentStatusAwaitingInput:
		return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeContent
	case entity.DocumentStatusPreparingSignature,
		entity.DocumentStatusReadyToSign,
		entity.DocumentStatusSigning,
		entity.DocumentStatusCompleted:
		return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModePDF
	default:
		return documentuc.ReadonlyViewModeUnavailable
	}
}

func (s *ReadonlyViewService) loadReadonlyContent(ctx context.Context, doc *entity.Document) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	version, err := s.versionRepo.FindByID(ctx, doc.TemplateVersionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finding template version: %w", err)
	}
	portableDoc, err := parsePortableDocument(version.ContentStructure)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing document content: %w", err)
	}
	if portableDoc == nil || portableDoc.Content == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("document has no content")
	}
	return json.Marshal(portableDoc.Content)
}
```

Add to `readonly_view_service.go`:

```go
func (s *ReadonlyViewService) GetReadonlyViewPDF(ctx context.Context, token string) ([]byte, string, error) {
	accessToken, err := s.validateReadonlyToken(ctx, token)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	doc, err := s.documentRepo.FindByID(ctx, accessToken.DocumentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("finding document: %w", err)
	}
	if readonlyViewModeForStatus(doc.Status) != documentuc.ReadonlyViewModePDF {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("PDF is not available for this document state")
	}
	if doc.IsCompleted() {
		return s.downloadCompletedReadonlyPDF(ctx, doc)
	}
	return s.renderReadonlyPreviewPDF(ctx, doc)
}

func (s *ReadonlyViewService) downloadCompletedReadonlyPDF(ctx context.Context, doc *entity.Document) ([]byte, string, error) {
	if !s.storageEnabled || s.storageAdapter == nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("signed PDF storage is disabled")
	}
	storageKey := completedPDFStorageKey(doc.CompletedPDFURL)
	if storageKey == "" {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("signed PDF not available for this document")
	}
	data, err := s.storageAdapter.Download(ctx, &port.StorageRequest{Key: storageKey})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("downloading signed PDF: %w", err)
	}
	return data, signedDocumentFilename(doc), nil
}

func (s *ReadonlyViewService) renderReadonlyPreviewPDF(ctx context.Context, doc *entity.Document) ([]byte, string, error) {
	if s.pdfRenderer == nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("PDF renderer is not configured")
	}
	version, err := s.versionRepo.FindByID(ctx, doc.TemplateVersionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("finding template version: %w", err)
	}
	portableDoc, err := parsePortableDocument(version.ContentStructure)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("parsing document content: %w", err)
	}
	if portableDoc == nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("document has no content")
	}
	var injectables map[string]any
	if doc.InjectedValuesSnapshot != nil {
		_ = json.Unmarshal(doc.InjectedValuesSnapshot, &injectables)
	}
	renderResult, err := s.pdfRenderer.RenderPreview(ctx, &port.RenderPreviewRequest{Document: portableDoc, Injectables: injectables})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("rendering readonly PDF: %w", err)
	}
	return renderResult.PDF, signedDocumentFilename(doc), nil
}
```

// CreateReadonlyViewLink creates a fresh expiring read-only contract view link.
// @Summary Create read-only contract view link
// @Tags Documents
// @Accept json
// @Produce json
// @Param X-Workspace-ID header string true "Workspace ID"
// @Param documentId path string true "Document ID"
// @Success 200 {object} dto.CreateReadonlyViewLinkResponse
// @Failure 403 {object} dto.ErrorResponse
// @Failure 404 {object} dto.ErrorResponse
// @Router /api/v1/documents/{documentId}/view-link [post]
func (c *DocumentController) CreateReadonlyViewLink(ctx *gin.Context) {
	if c.readonlyViewUC == nil {
		respondError(ctx, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Errorf("readonly view use case is not configured"))
		return
	}
	result, err := c.readonlyViewUC.CreateReadonlyViewLink(ctx.Request.Context(), ctx.Param("documentId"))
	if err != nil {
		HandleError(ctx, err)
		return
	}
	ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.CreateReadonlyViewLinkResponse{URL: result.URL, Token: result.Token, ExpiresAt: result.ExpiresAt})
}

```go
package controller

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

	"github.com/TetherEducation/doc-assembly/core/internal/adapters/primary/http/dto"
	documentuc "github.com/TetherEducation/doc-assembly/core/internal/core/usecase/document"
)

// PublicReadonlyViewController handles tokenized read-only contract views.
type PublicReadonlyViewController struct {
	readonlyViewUC documentuc.ReadonlyViewUseCase
}

// NewPublicReadonlyViewController creates a public read-only view controller.
func NewPublicReadonlyViewController(readonlyViewUC documentuc.ReadonlyViewUseCase) *PublicReadonlyViewController {
	return &PublicReadonlyViewController{readonlyViewUC: readonlyViewUC}
}

// RegisterRoutes registers public read-only view routes.
func (c *PublicReadonlyViewController) RegisterRoutes(router gin.IRouter) {
	view := router.Group("/public/view")
	{
		view.GET("/:token", c.GetReadonlyView)
		view.GET("/:token/pdf", c.GetReadonlyViewPDF)
	}
}

// GetReadonlyView returns public read-only contract metadata.
// @Summary Get read-only contract view
// @Tags Public Readonly View
// @Produce json
// @Param token path string true "View token"
// @Success 200 {object} dto.ReadonlyViewResponse
// @Failure 401 {object} dto.ErrorResponse
// @Router /public/view/{token} [get]
func (c *PublicReadonlyViewController) GetReadonlyView(ctx *gin.Context) {
	resp, err := c.readonlyViewUC.GetReadonlyView(ctx.Request.Context(), ctx.Param("token"))
	if err != nil {
		HandleError(ctx, err)
		return
	}
	ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ReadonlyViewResponse{
		Mode:           string(resp.Mode),
		DocumentID:     resp.DocumentID,
		DocumentTitle:  resp.DocumentTitle,
		DocumentStatus: string(resp.DocumentStatus),
		ExpiresAt:      resp.ExpiresAt,
		Content:        resp.Content,
		PDFURL:         resp.PDFURL,
		Reason:         resp.Reason,
	})
}

// GetReadonlyViewPDF returns PDF bytes for a read-only view token.
// @Summary Get read-only contract PDF
// @Tags Public Readonly View
// @Produce application/pdf
// @Param token path string true "View token"
// @Success 200 {file} binary
// @Failure 401 {object} dto.ErrorResponse
// @Router /public/view/{token}/pdf [get]
func (c *PublicReadonlyViewController) GetReadonlyViewPDF(ctx *gin.Context) {
	pdf, filename, err := c.readonlyViewUC.GetReadonlyViewPDF(ctx.Request.Context(), ctx.Param("token"))
	if err != nil {
		HandleError(ctx, err)
		return
	}
	ctx.Header("Content-Disposition", "inline; filename=\""+filename+"\"")
	ctx.Data(http.StatusOK, "application/pdf", pdf)
}
```

import axios from 'axios'
import type { ReadonlyViewResponse } from '../types'

const BASE_PATH = (import.meta.env.VITE_BASE_PATH || '').replace(/\/$/, '')

const publicApi = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_PATH,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

})

  return data
}

}

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Document, Page, pdfjs } from 'react-pdf'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, FileText } from 'lucide-react'
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/AnnotationLayer.css'
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/TextLayer.css'

pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = new URL(
  'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs',
  import.meta.url,
).toString()

interface ReadonlyPdfViewerProps {
  pdfUrl: string
  title: string
}

export function ReadonlyPdfViewer({ pdfUrl, title }: ReadonlyPdfViewerProps) {
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number>(0)
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1)

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-muted/30">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b bg-background px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <h1 className="text-sm font-semibold">{title}</h1>
        </div>
        {numPages > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="icon"
              disabled={pageNumber <= 1}
              onClick={() => setPageNumber((page) => Math.max(1, page - 1))}
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
            <span>
              {pageNumber} / {numPages}
            </span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="icon"
              disabled={pageNumber >= numPages}
              onClick={() => setPageNumber((page) => Math.min(numPages, page + 1))}
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </header>
      <main className="flex flex-1 justify-center overflow-auto p-6">
        <Document
          file={pdfUrl}
          onLoadSuccess={({ numPages }) => {
            setNumPages(numPages)
            setPageNumber(1)
          }}
          loading={<p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Cargando PDF...</p>}
          error={<p className="text-sm text-destructive">No se pudo cargar el PDF.</p>}
        >
          <Page pageNumber={pageNumber} width={900} />
        </Document>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement page component**

Create `/Users/rendis/Documents/Projects/Libraries/doc-assembly/app/src/features/readonly-view/components/ReadonlyContractViewPage.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { DocumentEditor } from '@/features/editor/components/DocumentEditor'
import { usePaginationStore, useSignerRolesStore } from '@/features/editor/stores'
import { AlertCircle, Eye, Lock } from 'lucide-react'
import { getReadonlyView, getReadonlyViewPdfUrl } from '../api/readonly-view-api'
import type { ReadonlyViewResponse } from '../types'
import { ReadonlyPdfViewer } from './ReadonlyPdfViewer'

interface ReadonlyContractViewPageProps {
  token: string
}

export function ReadonlyContractViewPage({ token }: ReadonlyContractViewPageProps) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<ReadonlyViewResponse | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    usePaginationStore.getState().reset()
    useSignerRolesStore.getState().reset()
  }, [token])

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    getReadonlyView(token)
      .then((response) => {
        if (!cancelled) setData(response)
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setError('No se pudo cargar el enlace de lectura.')
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false)
      })
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [token])

  if (loading) {
    return <CenteredMessage text="Cargando contrato..." />
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return <CenteredMessage icon="error" text={error ?? 'El enlace no está disponible.'} />
  }

  if (data.mode === 'pdf') {
    return <ReadonlyPdfViewer pdfUrl={getReadonlyViewPdfUrl(token)} title={data.documentTitle} />
  }

  if (data.mode === 'unavailable') {
    return <CenteredMessage icon="error" text="Este contrato no está disponible para lectura." />
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Eye className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-sm font-semibold">{data.documentTitle}</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Estado: {data.documentStatus}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
          Solo lectura
        </div>
      </header>
      <main className="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
        <DocumentEditor
          key={data.documentId}
          initialContent={JSON.stringify(data.content ?? { type: 'doc', content: [] })}
          editable={false}
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

function CenteredMessage({ text, icon }: { text: string; icon?: 'error' }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background p-6 text-center">
      {icon === 'error' ? (
        <AlertCircle className="mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-destructive" />
      ) : (
        <Eye className="mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground" />
      )}
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{text}</p>
    </div>
  )
}
```
